title: bhote topic
description: One topic as printed by `bhote show --json`, `bhote list --json` (array items) and every changing command with --json. A value that is not set is null.

id.description: Stable id, <created epoch>-<random>. Never changes, also not across machines.

n.description: Position in `bhote list --all` at the moment of the call. Usable as <ref> right away; changes when topics change.

waiting_for.description: Who the topic waits for; only set while status is waiting.

waiting_since.description: Unix time (seconds) since when it waits; only set while status is waiting.

agent.description: The herdr agent the topic was handed to (panel: s), or null.

machine.description: Machine label (HOST_LABEL or a saved herdr machine).

updated.description: Unix time (seconds) of the last change; the newer one wins when replicas are merged.
